source: Starting point, not official. 116 BPM from two tab transcriptions (Carl Culpepper / Skyminds; Guitar Tabs Explorer). Clean amp, bright, little reverb (tonesmatch 'riff clean': bass 5.5, mid 4, treble 7, presence 5.5, reverb low; says no pedal on the clean part). Light chorus and a soft quarter-note delay are a choice for the arpeggios, not documented.
